after.comment: Raw copies through NUL at site+0x1A, stride64, with no 20-byte bound; next dword stores begin +0x30. Shipped region prefix max16 plus signed-byte ordinal can use21 text bytes+NUL through +0x2F. Wire save remains20 bytes.

int
Raw LDRSB selects signed region ordinal; decimal formatting includes -128 after wrap. Shipped build-region prefix max16 gives longest label21 bytes before NUL; this live view includes two bytes skipped by save.
Raw save transfers exactly20 name bytes from site+0x1A. Runtime name may continue into +0x2E/+0x2F; these two bytes are not written to this wire field.
Raw load transfers exactly20 name bytes to site+0x1A. It does not restore runtime name tail bytes +0x2E/+0x2F.
